cases.name: brush-suite:special_parameters:34
cases.script:
function myfunc() {
    echo "--myfunc called--"

    echo "COUNT: $#"
    echo "AT-SIGN VALUE: '$@'"
    echo "STAR VALUE: '$*'"

    for arg in $@; do
        echo "AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '${arg}'"
    done

    for arg in $*; do
        echo "STAR ELEMENT: '${arg}'"
    done

    for arg in "$@"; do
      echo "DOUBLE-QUOTED AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '${arg}'"
    done

    for arg in "$*"; do
      echo "DOUBLE-QUOTED STAR ELEMENT: '${arg}'"
    done
}

myfunc
myfunc 1
myfunc 1 2
myfunc "a b c" 2
cases.stdout:
--myfunc called--
COUNT: 0
AT-SIGN VALUE: ''
STAR VALUE: ''
DOUBLE-QUOTED STAR ELEMENT: ''
--myfunc called--
COUNT: 1
AT-SIGN VALUE: '1'
STAR VALUE: '1'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '1'
STAR ELEMENT: '1'
DOUBLE-QUOTED AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '1'
DOUBLE-QUOTED STAR ELEMENT: '1'
--myfunc called--
COUNT: 2
AT-SIGN VALUE: '1 2'
STAR VALUE: '1 2'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '1'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '2'
STAR ELEMENT: '1'
STAR ELEMENT: '2'
DOUBLE-QUOTED AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '1'
DOUBLE-QUOTED AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '2'
DOUBLE-QUOTED STAR ELEMENT: '1 2'
--myfunc called--
COUNT: 2
AT-SIGN VALUE: 'a b c 2'
STAR VALUE: 'a b c 2'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: 'a'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: 'b'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: 'c'
AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '2'
STAR ELEMENT: 'a'
STAR ELEMENT: 'b'
STAR ELEMENT: 'c'
STAR ELEMENT: '2'
DOUBLE-QUOTED AT-SIGN ELEMENT: 'a b c'
DOUBLE-QUOTED AT-SIGN ELEMENT: '2'
DOUBLE-QUOTED STAR ELEMENT: 'a b c 2'

cases.name: prefix and local restoration
cases.script: : before; _=prefix echo "$_"; echo "$_"; f() { local _=local; : inner; echo "$_"; }; f call; echo "$_"

cases.name: unset recreated by command completion
cases.script: : before; unset _; printf "[%s]\n" "$_"; : again; echo "$_"

cases.name: readonly publication preserves command status
cases.script: : seed; readonly _; : next; echo "$_"
cases.stderr:
/usr/bin/bash: _: readonly variable
/usr/bin/bash: _: readonly variable
/usr/bin/bash: _: readonly variable

cases.name: nameref publication writes target
cases.script: x=hello; declare -n _=x; : after; printf "[%s]\n" "$x" "$_"

cases.name: readonly nameref target diagnostic and status
cases.script: x=seed; declare -n _=x; readonly x; : next; false final; printf "status=%s _=%s x=%s\n" "$?" "$_" "$x"
cases.stderr:
/usr/bin/bash: x: readonly variable
/usr/bin/bash: x: readonly variable
